request: Build an autonomous software factory into the existing Taskboard plugin, inspired by https://github.com/lpbaril/bb-plugin-factory. Make Linear, Jira, or the configured issue provider the source of truth. The factory should continuously select eligible tickets, start and supervise BB agent work, avoid duplicate dispatch, recover after restart, and reflect progress back through the existing Taskboard provider/status model. Reuse the current taskboard architecture and keep the first implementation focused and operable.
message: Updated the executable plan to replace duplicate ticket-team and run-insight views with one operator console, preserve all current actions and recovery boundaries, add explicit current-versus-history selection, compose responsive ticket context in TrackerDetail, isolate browser fixtures, and verify the production UI at 1280, 800, and 390 px. Retained the affected behavioral test inventory.

sizeDecision.reason: The eight criteria describe one atomic queue-admission capability: settings, durable claim, scheduler, status, UI, and verification share one project policy and cannot ship independently without either exposing an inert control or allowing uncontrolled admission.
